text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Well then—I'll head over to the dorms first. See you again at training—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...During this training camp,

that she is carrying—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Under the summer sun,
I quietly steeled my resolve.
